id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

selectedMetricId.description: The id of the currently selected {@link ReliabilityMetric}  in the grid.

selectedMetricRowData.description:
The row data of the currently selected {@link ReliabilityMetric} in the grid.
Useful populating data related a {@link ReliabilityMetric} in the side panel.

metricFormValues.description: The values of the {@link ReliabilityMetric} in the current form.

childMetrics.description: The list of {@link ReliabilityMetric}s that are associated with the current {@link ReliabilityMetric}.

currentPlottedMetricSpec.description: The current {@link CreateMetricConfigurationPreviewChartHelperSpec} that is being used to plot the preview chart.

isExpressionValid.description:
Validation status of the expression entered in the expression editor.
If true, that means that the expression is valid.
If false, that means that either the expression is invalid or it has not been validated yet.
This is used on the UI, for enabling/disabling the button to create or update a {@link ReliabilityMetric}.

isNewMetric.description:
Flag to indicate if the metric being configured is a new metric or an existing metric.
If true, that means that the metric is new. So, the UI will not be pre-populated with the values of an existing
metric and the UI will be in the create mode.

redirectTo.description: Stores where the user should be redirected to if they hit "exit anyway" in the exit modal

title: Application state for the {@link ReliabilityMetric} configuration workflow.
name: MetricConfigApplicationState
